en.hubeali:
Sahl, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Al Husayn Bin Umar Bin Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Forgives during the Month of Ramazan (every one) except for three – the partaken of an intoxicant, or a player of the two kings (Chess), or a bickerer’.
en.sarwar: 10. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from al-Husayn ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
In the month of Ramadan Allah forgives certain people except a drunk person, a chess playing person and a heretic.’”
